slopeFactorsComment: actualSlopeArea = planArea * (1 / cos(pitchRadians)). Used when the user gives a PLAN/footprint area; skipped when they give the actual roof surface area.

perimeterHeuristics.comment: Geometry allowances are used only when the customer explicitly asks the assistant to estimate roof-component lengths. They are never added automatically.

rounding.rule: Round each line subtotal and the total UP to the nearest 10 pounds (commercial conservative rounding). Quantities rounded up to the nearest 0.5 m2 / lm.

v4.comment: V4 guided-estimator configuration. These commercial values must never be hardcoded in components - always read them from here.

reroofAllowances.assumptionNote: Strip and disposal are indicative allowances. Site conditions, hazardous materials, difficult access, structural work or unusual disposal requirements are not included.

disclaimer: Indicative estimate only - not a formal quote. Subject to free site inspection, confirmed measurements, access, timber condition and final material selection.
standardAssumptions: Waste allowance of 7.5% included on the main roof covering quantity
No scaffolding beyond standard single-storey access
Existing roof structure assumed sound - timber repairs priced separately if needed

reroofBundles.comment: Base roof-system rates include underlay, battens, fixings, dry verge and labour. Existing-roof strip and disposal are separate configurable re-roof allowances.
